'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Jeremy Gardner DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeremy Gardner]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time (Virtual Block 1)|Imperial Entanglements / No One To Stop Us This Time]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
